note: Pack acceptance drills with their sha256. A drill spec never changes without an ADR amendment; a failed drill routes to fixing the pack and re-running. A.meaning: Spec committed before any pack content existed.

B.meaning: Spec and pack landed together; the spec is not an independent oracle.

C.meaning: Added at the 2026-08-08 pre-release review to cover gaps the first twenty left. Written after their packs, so they carry the Wave B guarantee. Documented here on 2026-08-15: the wave had entries and no entry of its own.

D.meaning: Spec committed while the capability was a registry-only row and no pack existed at all, so the spec cannot have been written to suit one.

E.meaning: Spec written for a pack that already existed. Not an independent oracle.

fields.spec: The frozen copy under benchmark/drills/, and the only copy of the drill text. The pack's research organ used to hold a second byte-identical copy that nothing compared, so it now points here instead.
fields.sha256: SHA-256 of the frozen copy at freeze time. A mismatch is a cannot-run.
fields.source: The pack's own drill proposal the frozen copy was taken from. Provenance, not a second copy: read it at source_first_commit to see the text as proposed.
fields.wave: A, B or C. Wave A packs were authored first, Wave B second, and Wave C drills were added at the 2026-08-08 pre-release review to cover gaps the earlier two left.
fields.frozen_before_authoring: True when the spec was committed before any of its pack's content existed, so the pack could not have been written to the drill.
fields.source_first_commit: First commit holding the drill spec.
fields.pack_first_commit: First commit holding the pack's PACK.md.
fields.how_to_read_it: Wave A specs landed in fb634ab and their packs in 00fbaba, four commits later, so the flag is true. Wave B specs and packs both landed in a43c20b, the same commit, so the flag is false and the evidence for it is in the two commit fields.
fields.pack: The pack the drill exercises. Present where the drill key is not itself a pack name, which happens when a pack has more than one drill.
